_comment: Toriano (working id metropolis). Generated from a street plan; see docs/locations/metropolis.md. Buildings with y and an interior are rooms on their own storey; floors are balconies, terraces, stairs and the old bridge's deck.

nodes.label: Dig through the skip
lines: Head first into the skip. Half a radiator and some old bricks!
Bricks, a bent pipe, and a builder's calendar from 1987.
A coil of conduit and three perfectly good bricks. The builders throw away anything.
Old bricks, a bicycle bell and somebody's lunch. Not yours.

nodes.label: Pull wire off the depot's scrap pile
lines: Thirty metres of old overhead wire. Carlotta won't miss it.
Copper wire, a tram bell, and a pigeon who was here first.
A tangle of tram wire and a timetable from 1979. Still more accurate than the new one.

nodes.label: Rummage at the flea-market stall
lines: Two curtains and a tablecloth for a few coins' worth of charm.
Velvet offcuts from a theatre that closed in 1971. Smells of applause.
A bolt of tartan and a lampshade with opinions.

nodes.text: You dig up a Roman coin with a very smug emperor on it!
You dig up a clay oil lamp, two thousand years old and still sooty!
You dig up a bronze hairpin. Somebody looked very elegant in it!
You dig up a fragment of mosaic: half a dolphin!

fish.name: Old Bicycle
fish.caught: You fished out an old bicycle! The Naviglio gives back what the fog takes.

fish.name: Shopping Trolley
fish.caught: A shopping trolley! Still has a coin in the slot.

fish.name: Old Boot
fish.caught: An old boot. Just the one. Somewhere in Toriano, a man is limping.

fish.name: Carp
fish.caught: A fat canal carp! It looks as surprised as you are.

lost: a Walkman with a tape of Christmas songs
